payload.statement_nl: Let n be an integer with n > 1 and let r be a real number with 0 <= r < 1. If m = floor(n*r), then m <= n*r < m + 1.

result_payload.proof_nl: Let t = nr. By the definition of the floor function, m = \lfloor t \rfloor if and only if m is an integer and m \le t < m+1. Since m = \lfloor nr \rfloor = \lfloor t \rfloor, it follows immediately that m \le nr < m+1. This is exactly the desired inequality.
result_payload.proof_summary: Directly apply the defining property of the floor function to t = nr.
